 Medicare enrollment is open now 
 By 
 News Staff 
 on Tuesday, November 10, 2026
 Medicare enrollment is open now 
 Medicare open enrollment is going on until Dec. 7, giving us the opportunity to change our health coverage and drug plans, if we wish to do so ... after we wade through all the information for 2027.
 Medicare.gov/plan-compare is your place to go to compare the plans available on pharmacies, drugs and providers.
